provenance: Original source-derived diagram layout with unmodified official Microsoft Azure service icons; not a live inventory or performance benchmark.

phases.title: Teacher shapes the course
phases.caption: 01 / A teacher sets the course intent and reviews its materials and learning design.

phases.title: Learner takes a turn
phases.caption: 02 / A learner asks, practises, or explains through the course-grounded teaching experience.

phases.title: Services support the interaction
phases.caption: 03 / The platform uses managed agents, course search, and application storage.

phases.title: People inspect the result
phases.caption: 04 / Learning artifacts and scoped insights return to people; outputs are not proof of mastery.

phases.title: Main web experience
phases.caption: 01 / The main web bundle hosts learner chat, course creation, artifacts, and teacher views.

phases.title: Main application API
phases.caption: 02 / The main API owns course access, teaching turns, materials, and in-process workers.

phases.title: Separate administration
phases.caption: 03 / Admin analytics uses its own API through a required external access boundary.

phases.title: API-owned integrations
phases.caption: 04 / The APIs call managed services directly; the admin API is not a proxy for the main API.

phases.title: Authorize the request
phases.caption: 01 / Typed chat routes verify an active user and course access before the teaching turn.

phases.title: Contextualise
phases.caption: 02 / Build scoped context. Show Contextualising while profile and grounding are prepared.

phases.title: Coordinate agent and tools
phases.caption: 03 / The harness calls the named Foundry TA and dispatches local tool calls and results.

phases.title: Stream and reconcile
phases.caption: 04 / Adapters deliver text and artifacts; the chat hook handles state, stop, errors, and persistence.

phases.title: Store course materials
phases.caption: 01 / Teacher materials enter Blob Storage and persisted material-processing jobs.

phases.title: Extract and embed
phases.caption: 02 / Document Intelligence structures the material; embeddings make chunks retrievable.

phases.title: Retrieve within course scope
phases.caption: 03 / Azure AI Search holds the shared index; course/session filters constrain retrieval.

phases.title: Return grounded passages
phases.caption: 04 / The teaching turn receives selected passages and source metadata for cited responses.

phases.title: Capture durable evidence
phases.caption: 01 / Accept a scoped learner event with a durable receipt; processing happens asynchronously.

phases.title: Validate the interpretation
phases.caption: 02 / Model observations need source evidence and validation; confidence does not write state.

phases.title: Apply deterministic policy
phases.caption: 03 / Reviewed curriculum and accepted evidence constrain deterministic state transitions.

phases.title: Publish and inform the next turn
phases.caption: 04 / Publish snapshot and history atomically; derive bounded context, gaps, and next probes.
